text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: The kitty pose you see at the racetrack♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Make a U-shape with your arms for the 
horseshoe pose♪

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, what have you been up to this whole 
time?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
It's Umamusume yoga~! Apparently, it's 
super popular among celebrity Umamusume 
right now!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Onee-chan, you try it too! Look, 
put your arms behind your back...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Pose like an Umamusume leaning super far 
forward! Now, hold that pose for a loooong 
time~.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...My back felt like it was about to cramp 
up. I don't know how you manage to keep 
going like that.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe♡ I'm super proud of my flexibility~♪ 
Thanks to it, I can zoom right along!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Right. To widen my stride, flexibility 
is... Hey, do you have any other 
recommended stretches?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"...! I do, I totally do! Ehehe, teaching 
big sister something is the exact opposite 
of usual!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Then I'm the big sister today! ♡ I'll 
teach you all sorts of things!!
